skill_name: Write a short story that takes place in the future and explores a technology advancement.
workflow: In the future, we were living in a technological utopia. Life had become much easier now, thanks to the advancements in artificial intelligence and technology. We were connected to the internet at all times, thanks to our implanted chips and augmented reality devices. Our daily lives were made simpler by robot servants who did the day-to-day housework and chores, and everyone had access to medical and educational facilities of the highest quality.
